description: Fetches a single submission by its responseId (from list_responses): answers keyed by questionId, createTime, lastSubmittedTime, respondentEmail and totalScore when available. Map questionId to the question text via get_form.

form_id.description: The form id — the long id from the form URL (docs.google.com/forms/d/<formId>/edit) or from create_form output.
